rationale: Record a Pulp-owned correction to a coordinate query inside the watched view surface. ViewInspector::absolute_bounds walked the parent chain summing bounds() alone, so any descendant of a scrolled container reported its unscrolled position and every appearance, overlap and clipping detector built on it judged only the first viewport-worth of a long panel. This adds View::child_paint_offset(), the translation a container applies to its children's paint, overrides it in ScrollView to return the active scroll offset, and accumulates it in that walk. applies_child_paint_offset() is re-expressed in terms of the new primitive with its semantics unchanged. The change corrects what a bounds query reports; it does not change what is painted, adds no rendering or backend path, no new event source, and no production paint behavior. This changes no design ingest, no captured output, no rendering, layout or packaging behavior, no accepted expansion boundary, and no Vellum source authority.
